content.introduction: The latest technology news from Yahoo Finance includes updates on the AI boom, with a focus on a key metric, and mentions of Micron Technology, Alphabet Inc., and Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company. Additionally, there are reports on the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq selling off due to inflation worries, and the 10-year Treasury yield reaching its highest level since 2007. Yahoo Tech highlights news across various categories including tech, politics, and science, with specific mentions of a new plan for ChatGPT costing $500 a month and the launch of GPT-6.1 Sol by OpenAI. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to specific questions about these topics.
